final: WITH grouped AS (SELECT o.timespan, AVG(1.0 * f.rebrate / f.feerate) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS match_count FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), stats AS (SELECT AVG(match_count) AS avg_count FROM grouped) SELECT AVG(g.avg_ratio) AS average_of_group_average_ratios, SUM(g.match_count) AS total_match_count, AVG(g.match_count - s.avg_count) AS average_excess_match_count FROM grouped g CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE g.match_count > s.avg_count
